suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and synth-pop fusion featuring male vocals. The track utilizes a prominent, syncopated slap bass line that interacts with a crisp electronic drum kit. A bright, staccato synth lead plays a repetitive four-note motif. The arrangement includes rhythmic vocal samples and percussive synth stabs. The tempo is 118 BPM in the key of G minor. The production features rapid-fire vocal delivery in the verses transitioning to melodic hooks. High-frequency synth arpeggios and digital sound effects provide rhythmic texture. The bridge features a stripped-back section with filtered synth pads before returning to the full groove.
